scope: single-treatment clean-only recipe diagnostic on the full frozen 512-image calibration pool
limitations: Historical checkpoint-selection evaluation partition, not a new confirmatory holdout.
One recipe branch with one engine build; no seed or build-population inference.
No continuation gate is applied: this branch diagnoses whether calibration budget explains the remaining clean-fidelity failure rather than authorizing a robustness study.
Calibration-budget sensitivity is a recipe-level observation, not a numerical-format causal claim.
A successful calibration repair is baseline engineering evidence, not a new robustness method.
